description: This file defines a set of tools for interacting with Google Docs and Drive APIs, including creating, retrieving, updating documents, and inserting text, images, and tables. It also exports a factory function to generate these tools based on specified actions.

classes.name: BaseGoogleDocsTool
classes.description: Base class providing methods to make authenticated requests to Google Docs and Drive APIs.

classes.name: CreateDocumentTool
classes.description: Tool for creating a new Google Docs document and optionally adding content.

classes.name: GetDocumentTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving a Google Docs document by ID.

classes.name: UpdateDocumentTool
classes.description: Tool for updating a Google Docs document with batch requests.

classes.name: InsertTextTool
classes.description: Tool for inserting text into a Google Docs document.

classes.name: ReplaceTextTool
classes.description: Tool for replacing text in a Google Docs document.

classes.name: AppendTextTool
classes.description: Tool for appending text to the end of a Google Docs document.

classes.name: GetTextContentTool
classes.description: Tool for extracting text content from a Google Docs document.

classes.name: InsertImageTool
classes.description: Tool for inserting an image into a Google Docs document.

classes.name: CreateTableTool
classes.description: Tool for creating a table in a Google Docs document.

methods.name: makeGoogleDocsRequest
methods.description: Performs an authenticated request to the Google Docs API.

methods.name: makeDriveRequest
methods.description: Performs an authenticated request to the Google Drive API.

methods.name: createGoogleDocsTools
methods.description: Factory function to generate Google Docs tools based on specified actions.
